content: make me a banana wearing sunglasses

Your banana is in the Workspace as "Banana With Sunglasses", with every part clearly named for what it is: Banana Body, Banana Tip, Banana Stem, Sunglasses Lens Left, Sunglasses Lens Right, Sunglasses Bridge, Sunglasses Arm Left, Sunglasses Arm Right, and Banana Smile. I read the lens parts back and confirmed they're dark (near-black) in color, so the sunglasses are indeed dark shades.

What I did not check: how it looks after my last changes.
